name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 87 – Am 8
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 87b. Strongly condemns the fact that in many Member States, authorities have enforced disproportionate measures, such as pre-emptive banning of public gatherings in solidarity with Palestine, based on risk to ‘public order’ and ‘security’; condemns, furthermore, the use of excessive force and violence by authorities, the detention of protesters and the conflation of criticism of Israeli authorities with antisemitism, leading to a chilling effect and an atmosphere of repression; stresses that, in several cases, the bans have been appealed against, and courts have intervened against banning protests in solidarity with Palestine; condemns, at the highest political level, unlawful restrictions on the right to freedom of peaceful assembly and expression;
